# Bonanza

> > Bonanza is a peer-to-peer online marketplace featuring low fees, Google Shopping integration, and curated categories from 25,000+ sellers offering everything from vintage collectibles to contemporary fashion.

Bonanza operates as an alternative e-commerce platform to major marketplaces like eBay and Etsy, emphasizing low transaction fees and seamless product discovery across multiple categories. The platform serves both buyers seeking unique items at competitive prices and sellers looking for an accessible online selling platform with built-in promotional tools.

## Key Topics

- Online marketplace
- Low-fee selling
- Google Shopping integration
- Vintage items
- Product discovery
- Category browsing
- Trending items
- Seller booth
- E-commerce platform

## Getting Started

- [Bonanza Home](https://www.bonanza.com): Bonanza main marketplace homepage with multi-category shopping
- [Bonanza Home Page](https://www.bonanza.com/home): Bonanza home page featuring trending items and product discovery
- [Login](https://www.bonanza.com/booths/my_booth_redirect): Bonanza login page for user account and booth access
- [Sign Up](https://www.bonanza.com/users/create_intro_user): User signup page for Bonanza marketplace with 25,000+ sellers

## Selling on Bonanza

- [Sell Products Online](https://www.bonanza.com/sell_products_online): Bonanza marketplace for online sellers with low fees and Google Shopping integration

## Shopping Categories

- [Collectibles](https://www.bonanza.com/collectibles): Bonanza collectibles marketplace with antiques and memorabilia
- [Antiques](https://www.bonanza.com/antiques): Bonanza antiques category with vintage furniture and collectibles
- [Fashion](https://www.bonanza.com/fashion): Bonanza fashion category with clothing, shoes, and accessories
- [Home & Garden](https://www.bonanza.com/home___garden): Bonanza home and garden category with decor and furniture
- [Health & Beauty](https://www.bonanza.com/health___beauty): Bonanza health and beauty category with wellness products
- [Art](https://www.bonanza.com/art): Bonanza art category featuring prints, paintings, and photography
- [Crafts](https://www.bonanza.com/crafts): Bonanza crafts category with supplies and handmade items

## Community & Support

- [Community Forum](https://www.bonanza.com/community): Bonanza community forum for seller help and user discussions
